problem: A shared wall or corridor-route distance does not satisfy an explicit request for direct room-to-room access. Existing room bays always had separate corridor doors but no inter-room opening.
implementation: Explicit direct_door relationship with minimum clear width and mandatory boolean lockable intent
Same-side shared partition opening, wall subtraction, two-sided approach rectangles, connected clear aisles, furniture/seat and conservative door-swing checks
Separate audit validates opening coverage, dimensions, intent, entries and swing geometry; scene and saved CAD retain identifiable direct-door attributes
Door schedule CSV and source-bound relation text; shared-space handoff retains the original corridor entry and adds both new room-face entries
Native placement supports groups of each declared symbol, retaining the old single-symbol path for previous plans

sourceProbe.purpose: Independent public requirement exposes the missing connection capability; it does not provide the test shell or certify completion of that commission

limits: Native regression uses a separately declared development shell, areas, furniture and 900mm door width. These are not dimensions or issued architectural conditions of the public commission. The declared development design date is 2026-10-21; execution occurred on 2026-10-23.

Only same-side rectangular bays with a complete shared partition are supported. Bounded opening positions and conservative swing envelopes can reject a practically feasible design; no general layout or global infeasibility claim.

Existing corridor doors remain. The new relation does not enforce exclusive secure access or an access-control policy. Existing route constraints remain corridor-based, not a general shortest-path network.

Lockable is an explicit intent carried into the model, CAD attributes and schedule; hardware approval stays false. Fire rating, actual lock/hinge selection, accessible operation and construction details require review.

The public clause also demands cabinets, a safe and a copier; those placements and other reception/cash/comms/cooling requirements remain unimplemented or unverified. This is not completion of the public project.
No new actual AI interpretation, unfamiliar-project acceptance, external user, new machine or professional signature. Hospital remains a separate retrospective case.
Frozen v2.0/v2.1 tags and packages remain unchanged; this is an unreleased main-branch capability increment.
